title: 2026 UK GHG solid-waste methodology-change QA controls

sources.publisher: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero
sources.title: UK greenhouse gas emissions statistics: 2026 planned methodology changes

sources.publisher: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero
sources.title: Final UK greenhouse gas emissions statistics: 1990 to 2024

facts.source_fact: The 2026 methodology note was updated on 15 January 2026 and describes planned changes for the final 1990-2024 UK GHG statistics.
facts.expected_handling: Keep planning-note status and date with the method evidence.

facts.source_fact: Impact estimates in the methodology note were provisional before the final statistical release.
facts.expected_handling: Do not treat planning-note impacts as a final time series without final-publication cross-check.

facts.source_fact: The final 1990-2024 UK GHG statistics were published in 2026 and later updated on 25 June 2026.
facts.expected_handling: Use final-release versioning when consuming production statistics.

facts.source_fact: Historic solid-waste-disposal activity data are uncertain and unavailable before 1997.
facts.expected_handling: Represent pre-1997 activity as modelled rather than directly observed.

facts.source_fact: The previous method extrapolated 1990-1996 solid-waste disposal volumes from 1997 using household and employment statistics.
facts.expected_handling: Tag legacy estimates with the superseded extrapolation method.

facts.source_fact: An external review found the previous method inconsistent with IPCC inventory guidance.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve review rationale for the method change.

facts.source_fact: The updated landfill model uses GDP data as a proxy for solid-waste disposal volumes where actual activity data are unavailable.
facts.expected_handling: Record GDP-proxy provenance and the activity-data gap it addresses.

facts.source_fact: The solid-waste method change is exclusive to the waste sector.
facts.expected_handling: Do not propagate the adjustment to unrelated sectors.

facts.source_fact: The updated method produces a large decrease in landfill-emissions estimates over the early historic time series.
facts.expected_handling: Treat direction of change as methodology impact, not a new measured observation.

facts.source_fact: The planning note estimated a material negative effect on solid-waste emissions and reported impacts using MtCO2e and percentage-of-UK-total measures.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve units, reference years and provisional status when comparing impacts.

guard_patterns.handling: Bind values to method version and publication stage.
Distinguish planning-note impacts from final statistics.
guard_patterns.risk_prevented: Treating provisional impacts as final data.

guard_patterns.handling: Mark observed versus proxy/modelled activity data.
Preserve MtCO2e, percentages and reference years.
Apply one consistent method across comparable series segments.
Prefer DESNZ final release for final values.
guard_patterns.risk_prevented: Using planning material as final authority.

guard_patterns.handling: Do not infer parcel emissions from national methodology.
Flag unresolved version or data-source conflicts.

generation_rule: CARTESIAN_PRODUCT facts x guard_patterns; 10 x 10 = 100 controls
